title: Chern's Conjecture with Constant Cubic Trace
summary: We prove that the values set of \(S=|A|^2\) attained by closed embedded minimal hypersurfaces in \(\mathbb S^{n+1}(1)\) with constant \(S\) and constant \(f_3=\operatorname{tr}(A^3)\) is locally finite, where \(A\) denotes the shape operator. Neither the topology of the hypersurface nor the value of \(f_3\) is fixed.
